item.title: Commands
item.description:
termorq-cli is a Pro-only companion tool. Its commands are listed here for Pro builds; the CLI has no edition switch. See the Free and Pro feature breakdown for app features.

@ opens the commands palette. Type to filter. Entries from commands.yaml follow these built-ins. @history is always available and is not a line in that file.

The shortcuts dialog lists the same triggers. The shot is the macOS wording.

item.title: Keyboard
item.description:
Cmd+/ on macOS, or Ctrl+/ on Windows and Linux, opens the shortcuts dialog. Press it again, or Esc, to close. The header hint (⌘/ help or Ctrl+/ help) opens the same dialog.

The labels below are the macOS ones from that dialog. Where a row says Cmd, Windows and Linux use Ctrl for that shortcut, except Ctrl+C, Ctrl+Tab, Ctrl+wheel, and Ctrl+0, which stay Ctrl on every platform. Ctrl+Shift+C copies inside the interactive terminal. On macOS the normal copy shortcut is Cmd+C.

item.title: Files
item.description:
Two places hold state. The data folder is this machine. The workspace folder is what you commit.

Data folder link

com.garrardkitchen.ai-terminal under the platform data directory.

Platform Path
macOS ~/Library/Application Support/com.garrardkitchen.ai-terminal
Linux $XDG_DATA_HOME or ~/.local/share/com.garrardkitchen.ai-terminal
Windows %APPDATA%\com.garrardkitchen.ai-terminal
File What it is
collections.json The shelf. Older localStorage data is moved here once
command_history.json The last 500 commands and their times
api_connections.json API connections, without secret values
api_endpoints.json Endpoints
openai_connections.json Model connections, without the key
mcp_connections.json MCP servers, without secret values
ssh_connections.json SSH connections, without passwords or passphrases
ssh_known_hosts Host keys you trusted, in OpenSSH format. ~/.ssh/known_hosts is read, never written
mcp_prefs.json Favourites and related MCP preferences
network_settings.json The additional CA certificate setting

The keychain service is com.garrardkitchen.ai-terminal. An AES-256-GCM fallback file lives in this folder when the keychain cannot be used. Do not edit it to plant a token.
